content:
QF-PCR trisomy test for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21

NO ABNORMALITY DETECTED

PCR analysis of uncultured chorionic villi was carried out using markers specific for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21.

The results are consistent with a normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21.

A full karyotype analysis of G-banded chromosomes from cultured chorionic villi will follow from the South West Thames Regional Cytogenetics Unit.
